# @version CYBOP 0.19.0 2017-04-07
# @author Christian Heller <christian.heller@tuxtax.de>

Source Code
___________

Compile cyboi
Test cybol applications


Administrative Data
___________________

Adapt file "dist/prepare_release.sh"
Execute file "dist/prepare_release.sh"
Adapt directories, files, version in build/cmake/packaging.cmake
Update and delete old todo/* files
Update ChangeLog
Update AUTHORS reading ChangeLog entries
Update NEWS subsumpting ChangeLog entries
Commit SVN
Tag SVN
Pack
Upload tarball file to sftp://USERNAME@download.savannah.gnu.org/releases/cybop


Website
_______

Create new file for release in www/cybop/plan/
Copy content from NEWS to www/cybop/plan/cybop-x.x.x.html
Update www/cybop/plan/index.html
Update www/cybop/news.html
Update www/cybop/index.html
Update www/cybop/footer.inc
Commit CVS (website gets updated automatically)


Announcement
____________

Announce release in mailing list
